transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I'd like to get us started on the peer climate liaison pilot. As you all know, this is an eight-week pilot to give employees a neutral first contact for everyday collaboration concerns. The liaison can receive concerns and connect employees with support, but won't be investigating complaints or making disciplinary decisions. I'll be making the binding appointment and approving the operating arrangements. We have three candidates under consideration: Priya, Noah, and Tessa. Before we finalize anything, I need our team lead, employee experience partner, and HR operations specialist to formally disclose any relevant input as part of the staffing review. I also want to flag upfront that any required qualification must be verified before appointment — no provisional appointments — and any supervision requirement identified during the review will become a mandatory operating arrangement in the appointment decision. Let's hear from each of you.
